name: Miyo: Cat Simulator 3D

titles.ar: Miyo: محاكي القطة ثلاثي الأبعاد - سياسة الخصوصية

data_safety_notes: Child-directed app (Families Policy, ages 6-12). No accounts, chat, purchases, location, contacts or user-provided personal data; game progress is stored only on device (WebView localStorage). Only the Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob) collects/shares data, automatically, for advertising/marketing, analytics and fraud prevention/security: approximate location (derived from IP), app interactions, diagnostics (crash logs, performance), device or other IDs (app set ID; AD_ID permission removed, so no Android advertising ID on Android 13+). Ads are child-directed (TFCD+TFUA), non-personalized, max rating G. Data encrypted in transit (TLS, cleartext disabled). Users cannot request deletion via us (no data held by developer); policy explains. Since 17 Nov 2026 (app 1.2.x+): Firebase Analytics (anonymous app interactions; ad ID/SSAID collection off, ad storage/user data/personalization consent denied, Analytics retention 2 months) and Firebase Crashlytics (crash logs, diagnostics, Firebase installation ID; 90 days) for analytics/app functionality, encrypted in transit, not shared for advertising. Remote Config NOT present: when added, update Data safety and this policy first. See docs/firebase.md in the miyo repo. Verify against AdMob's current Play data disclosure page for the SDK version in the build.
